evidence.live: L: bounded in-step page snapshots of one physics substep (BEFORE at S2, AFTER at the C9 slot entry)
evidence.native: N: the original 0x18ae2c0 run in Unicorn over the BEFORE pages (memory image code, live .data pages)
evidence.model: engine.pose_island_step composed from reconstructed modules over the same BEFORE pages
evidence.note: Three separate comparisons; no claim of original-engine equivalence. A deterministic replay of a captured substep does not prove the reconstruction matches the engine in states that were not captured.

capture.plugin: private bounded snow-host plugin; only writes: one compare-exchanged vtable-pointer swap of the broadphase object (controller+0x28) to a private copy of its 34-slot table, restored and verified; slots +0x88/+0x98/+0xa8 forward always
capture.before_point: broadphase slot +0x88 inside 0x18b8fa0 (return 0x18b907b, S2): after the pair update, pair jobs and contact generation
capture.before_to_island_entry: static: rest of 0x18b8fa0 (counter +0x4c += 1, bp+8 and provider+0x180 = counter via 0x18df490, phase 2) is applied by the loader; then the protected lock transition 0x1c3d1e0 (not emulated, assumed not to write island records) and 0x140efa0 (tail jump)
capture.after_point: broadphase slot +0xa8 entry inside 0x18b9710 (return 0x18b9808, C9, called only when island+0x420 != 0): state right after C7-D10; nothing is written between the C7-D10 return (0x18b97ed) and this call
capture.stages_between_before_and_after: C1..C7-D10 of the island step only (C9 receiver, phase 0, C10a/C10b run after the AFTER read)
capture.substep_identity: caller frames checked at both points: 0x18ae2b9/0x1389b02 at S2 and 0x18ae2ce/0x1389b21 at C9, same timing record, outer counter, substep ordinal, dt bits and thread
capture.walker: structural walk (controller, world and settings, island, provider, stage, broadphase and its vectors, dispatcher, all active and inactive groups with bodies, metadata, entries, resources, profiles, profile byte maps, transforms, damping and quiet records, link rings, links, entries, payloads, poses, world constraint lists and sets, trees, command lists, C4 per-thread scratch) plus one level of pointer chase; whole 4 KiB pages; reads via ReadProcessMemory of the own process; walk time 1.4-11 ms per snapshot

comparison_method.native_vs_live: every byte of every page present in BEFORE, AFTER and the native result; differences classified as live_only (live wrote, native did not), predicted_only or both_differ, and attributed to the walked record containing them
comparison_method.model_vs_native: every byte of every retained model region at the C7-D10 boundary against the native memory at the same addresses
comparison_method.model_vs_live: float fields of every island body (linear/angular velocity, rotation rows, translation): max abs and max ulp

c4_finish.status: supplied as a no-op in both native-on-live and model-on-live
c4_finish.reason: with live data the swept-contact finish 0x195c040 reaches a broadphase proxy query (bp+0x60 proxies, 64-byte tree nodes at bp+0x70) and the shapes of every overlapping proxy, plus per-thread scratch lists of the global at 0x143336900; 22-32 pages per capture remained unmapped after two walker iterations, so its native run is incomplete and is not used
c4_finish.effect_on_comparison: its live writes appear as live_only differences: the stage object at controller+0x40 and the per-thread scratch in every capture, and in two captures new broadphase pair rows and one link entry/payload; in one capture an extra contact entry on a newly attached link changed one free body (see residuals)

model_composition_notes: harness-side composition of make_composed_batch_stage with damping records/response and quiet-override records plumbed (the engine function does not pass them; every live body has a damping record)
harness-side sphere resource bounds (class 0x29c9be8, routine 0x18c75a0: low = t - r, high = r + t), checked only through the byte comparison; the engine bounds dispatch covers box and capsule only
inline small-buffer arrays (group body/link arrays at group+0x20/+0x50, link entries at link+0x68, body entries at body+0xc8) are exposed to the model as views into their containing record
region sizes trimmed where live records are packed closer than the fixture sizes (resources 0x48, links 0x88)

limits: Wine on macOS, one build, dispatcher capacity 1 (inline worker); spawn-area riding only (captures within the first ~15 s of riding; riding was lost (KO) in all five sessions, 20-37 s after riding started, at about the same place on the spawn line; sr-01/sr-02 captures are excluded because their walker missed records (fixed later); the first KO-detecting coordinator ran from sr-03).
The C4 swept-contact finish is not replayed; substeps where it changes island records cannot pass.
Sequential self-reads inside the stepping thread, not atomic against other threads; co-located heap bytes written by other threads show up as live_only differences outside walked records.
The protected lock transition 0x1c3d1e0 between S2 and the island step is assumed not to write island records (consistent with the results).
Action tree and command collections were empty in every capture (C2/C3 callbacks not exercised); only kind-2 poses occurred; C5 attach ran with live changed links.
Native and model share the replayed services (atan2, damping library, allocator addresses); their agreement does not test those services.
